question.text: Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">Z</mi><mo>=</mo><mfenced close="]" open="["><mtable><mtr><mtd><mn>1</mn></mtd><mtd><mn>1</mn></mtd><mtd><mn>3</mn></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mn>5</mn></mtd><mtd><mn>1</mn></mtd><mtd><mn>2</mn></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mn>3</mn></mtd><mtd><mn>1</mn></mtd><mtd><mn>0</mn></mtd></mtr></mtable></mfenced></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi><mo>=</mo><mfenced close="]" open="["><mtable><mtr><mtd><mn>1</mn></mtd><mtd><mn>0</mn></mtd><mtd><mn>2</mn></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mn>2</mn></mtd><mtd><mn>1</mn></mtd><mtd><mn>0</mn></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mn>3</mn></mtd><mtd><mn>0</mn></mtd><mtd><mn>1</mn></mtd></mtr></mtable></mfenced></math>. If <math><mi mathvariant="normal">Z</mi><mo>=</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Q</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>, where <math><mi mathvariant="normal">Q</mi></math> is a square matrix of order <math><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo></math> then the value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Tr</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">j</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">Q</mi></mrow></mfenced><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> is equal to (where <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Tr</mi><mo>(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mo>)</mo></math> represents the trace of a matrix <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></math> i.e. the sum of all the diagonal elements of the matrix <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>adjB</mi></math> represents the adjoint matrix of matrix <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></math>)
